userStories.title: Add Approve & Queue button to SpecForgePreview so specs can be queued when a run is already active
userStories.description: In src/components/SpecForgePreview.tsx, the existing Approve & Run button calls POST /api/pipeline/trigger and shows an error toast when conflict: true is returned (a run is already active). There is no way to queue from Forge — users must navigate to Pipeline, find the spec, and queue manually. Fix this by adding an 'Approve & Queue' button (secondary, next to the existing Approve button) that approves the spec and triggers with queue: true. The backend POST /api/pipeline/trigger already accepts { queue: true } and returns { queued: true, runId, position } — no backend changes needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a new state variable in SpecForgePreview: const [queuingRun, setQueuingRun] = useState(false).

Add a new handler handleApproveAndQueue: async function that (1) calls handleApprove(false) to approve the spec without triggering a run — reuse existing approve logic; wait for approve to complete before proceeding. If approve fails, stop. (2) Calls POST /api/pipeline/trigger with body { specPath: `forge/specs/approved/${specSlug}.json`, workspaceId: triggerWorkspaceId, queue: true }. (3) On success (res.queued === true): show toast 'Queued at position #N' where N is res.position, call onReset?.(). (4) On res.ok (no conflict, ran immediately because queue was empty): show toast 'Spec approved — running now', navigate to run. (5) On error: show error toast. Set queuingRun true/false around the trigger call.

Add the Approve & Queue button to the action bar in the JSX at approximately line 533 (after the existing Approve button). It must: use label 'Approve & Queue', show Loader2 spinner while queuingRun is true, be disabled while approving, triggering, queuingRun, or rejecting, use the same secondary button styling as the existing Approve button (border border-border text-text hover:bg-surface-200), have a Queue icon (import Clock from lucide-react if not already imported).
The existing Approve & Run button behavior is unchanged. The existing Approve button behavior is unchanged. The new button is additive only.
After the change, run npx tsc --noEmit from the repo root — zero new type errors must be introduced in SpecForgePreview.tsx.
The handleApproveAndQueue function must be wrapped in useCallback with correct dependencies.
